source: TDD v1.1 §9.2 Schwartz-Informed Values Model and §9.3 Four Higher-Order Value Views. Basic values are listed first so higher-order views can reference them.

data.name: Self-direction
data.definition: Independent thought/action; creating, choosing and exploring.
data.consulting_interpretation: Hypothesis independence, intellectual courage, autonomous problem solving.

data.name: Stimulation
data.consulting_interpretation: Comfort with ambiguity and transformation; potential novelty bias.

data.name: Hedonism
data.consulting_interpretation: Work-energy preference; report descriptively, not as consulting capability.

data.name: Achievement
data.consulting_interpretation: Delivery drive, standards, career ambition; watch status-over-substance risk.

data.name: Power
data.definition: Status, prestige and control of people/resources.
data.consulting_interpretation: Influence/commercial leadership; develop collaborative use of authority.

data.name: Security
data.consulting_interpretation: Risk awareness, control, governance, delivery reliability.

data.name: Conformity
data.definition: Restraint to avoid harming others / violating expectations.
data.consulting_interpretation: Protocol discipline, client norms, quality; balance with constructive challenge.

data.name: Tradition
data.definition: Respect and commitment to established customs/ideas.
data.consulting_interpretation: Institutional respect and continuity; balance with future-state redesign.

data.name: Benevolence
data.definition: Welfare of people in close contact / in-group.
data.consulting_interpretation: Team support, mentoring, client care and dependable collaboration.

data.name: Universalism
data.definition: Understanding, tolerance and welfare of all people/nature.
data.consulting_interpretation: Stakeholder breadth, ESG/public value and global/systemic orientation.

data.name: Openness to Change
data.consulting_interpretation: Experimentation, autonomy, change orientation, ambiguity tolerance.

data.name: Self-Enhancement
data.consulting_interpretation: Achievement drive, influence, advancement and commercial ambition.

data.name: Conservation
data.consulting_interpretation: Stability, governance, duty, order, risk management and continuity.

data.name: Self-Transcendence
data.consulting_interpretation: Stakeholder welfare, collaboration, purpose, inclusivity and societal impact.
